$comment: Regression ceilings in gzipped bytes, checked by scripts/verify-package.mjs through .github/scripts/size-budget.mjs. Size is not a target: each ceiling sits about 15-20% above what was measured when it was set, to catch an accidental blow-up. Raise one on purpose, in the pull request that needs it, and update its reason.

..reason: Raised 2026-10-11 to about 19% over the 5,730 B measured with WowDatasetWordings (a dataset's wording, view engine D86); set 2026-09-30 at 5,400 B, 18% over 4,594 B. Measured 5,939 B on 2026-10-14, once the paths, the wire and the memory of writes moved into a chunk the /v10 entry shares (7.3a).

./v10.reason: Set 2026-10-14 (roadmap 7.3a) at about 19% over the 6,322 B measured: the V10 store, its dataset wording and the ViewSource adapter, the clients generated from the V10 view store's Manifest, and the chunk shared with the root entry.
